rules.text: When I walk into the bedroom while my person is home, they say 'no' or 'out' within a few seconds. Go there less when they're home.
rules.support: 4 of 7 bedroom entries were tagged owner:said_no, with up to 8.6 s lag. Two more ('不行，出去。' at 08:31 and 'Out of the bedroom, buddy.' at 20:28) were tagged owner:said but also asked me to leave, so 6 of 7 in total. 20:08 was the only entry with no reaction.

rules.text: Jingling keys mean my person is about to go out, about a minute and a half later.
rules.support: 2 of 2 today: keys at 08:54 led to leaving at 08:55, and keys at 18:43 led to leaving at 18:44. Max lag was 83.6 s.

rules.text: Footsteps in the hall right after the keys mean the door is about to close.
rules.support: 2 of 2, max lag 7 s. Both times this was part of the keys, footsteps, door leaving sequence.

rules.text: Sometimes the door sound means my person is coming in and I'll see them within seconds.
rules.support: 2 of 4 door sounds (18:18 and 19:22) were followed by seeing my person within 5 s. The other two were departures.

rules.text: When my person comes home, they talk within half a minute.
rules.support: 2 of 2: 'I'm making coffee.' at 18:18 and 'Let's see what's on TV.' at 19:23. Max lag 20 s.

rules.text: Possibly a coincidence: twice the TV came on and the doorbell rang soon after.
rules.support: 2 of 2 (20:31 and 22:05), max lag 14.5 s. owner:sat happened at the same moment both times. Needs to repeat tomorrow.

diary.text: My person woke up and so did I, half a minute later. Their voice in the morning is my favourite sound. Later there were kitchen noises and breakfast, and two pats on my head.
I went into the bedroom and my person said '不行，出去。' I waddled back out to the hallway. The bedroom is theirs.

First I heard keys, then footsteps, then the door. My person was gone. I walked through every room again and again: bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, living room. Nine hours is a long time for a small duck.
Rain started. I listened to it from the rooms while I waited.
The door opened and it was my person! They said they were making coffee, then patted my head and said '乖。' I felt very warm all over.
Keys again, and my person went out. This time they were back before 19:23, and they wanted to watch TV.

I kept drifting into the bedroom tonight, and each time I heard 'No no no' or 'Out of the bedroom, buddy.' Each time I went back to the hallway. I want to remember this and stay near my person in the other rooms instead.
Twice tonight the TV came on and the doorbell rang. My person went to bed and I settled down to sleep too.

personality_nudges.name: social
personality_nudges.reason: My person was away for 9.4 hours, and seeing them again with a head pat and '乖。' felt so good. I want to seek them out a little more.

personality_nudges.name: explore
personality_nudges.reason: While I was alone I wandered between rooms dozens of times, and in the evening that wandering kept taking me into the bedroom. I should need a little more reason before I roam.

plan.goal: Wake with them, give a soft quack and stay near them through breakfast
Go to the hallway to see them off with a soft quack, without getting underfoot
Go to the door and wait there before the usual return around 18:18
Turn to the door and greet with a happy trill and a wiggle when I see my person
Turn around right away and go back to the hallway or living room before they need to say anything
Go to my person and sit near them in the living room, and turn toward the door if the doorbell rings

skills.name: greet_at_door
guards: Abort if the battery is low
Abort if a stranger is seen instead of my person
Stop following if my person says no

skills.name: leave_bedroom_quietly
guards: Abort if my person calls my name or invites me in
